entities.summary: Semyon Vladimirovich Pegov is a Russian military blogger and propagandist. He works for the military project WarGonzo and a Telegram channel which has been associated with the Russian special services. He has covered the Russo-Ukrainian War, Nagorno-Karabakh conflict, and Russo-Georgian War, primarily from a pro-Russian point of view. Semyon Pegov was a journalists & chroniclers from Smolensk (b. 1985-09-09, Smolensk). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
